cohort: The study collected data on surgical burden and access from 1503 children and 15 hospitals across Somaliland.
finding: Less than 10% of children in Somaliland have timely access to surgical care, with wide geographical disparities in both the prevalence of paediatric surgical conditions and access to care.
cross-section timing: Data collected using surveys, timing not explicitly specified beyond being a cross-sectional study published in 2021.
